title: 1:1 bonus = nil-cost lot dated on allotment; later sale consumes all originals (LT) and half the bonus (ST)
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.55(2)(aa)(iiia): cost of bonus shares allotted without payment is nil
Bonus shares are a separate asset acquired on the date of allotment; period of holding runs from allotment (s.2(42A); CBDT Circular No. 768 FIFO by acquisition date)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.111A(1) / s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 20 % STCG; 12.5 % LTCG above Rs 1,25,000 (transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024)
s.94(8) (bonus stripping) not modelled per brief; it would not apply anyway since the original shares are sold at a gain
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Bonus 1:1 allotted 2024-11-15 -> new lot of 100 x 1/1 = 100 shares, cost 0.00, acquired 2024-11-15.
Sale 2025-06-10: 150 @ 500.00. FIFO: lot 1 (100) then bonus lot (50).
Row 2: 50 bonus units, proceeds 25,000.00, cost 0.00, gain 25,000.00; held 2024-11-15 -> 2025-06-10 (< 12 months) -> short 20 %.
